findings: OQ-120 (a), for this remark: (iii) l.930–931 holds for moved-p isomorphisms too. A move B ∈ SO₀(1,2), B·p = p', carries a lifted developing pair (θ, E, D, f) of L to (θ∘[B]⁻¹, φ∘E, D, f) of L' (same D, same lifted holonomy, θ∘[B]⁻¹ oriented since det B = 1) and keeps i⁺ (B orthochronous), so positivity and negativity are invariant and positive and negative circles are isomorphic through no move (GX.not_isIsoVia_of_positive_of_negative). The SCOPE (e) argument of HSSingularities.lean is now formalized. Either answer to (a) can be marked with no Lean change for this label.

OQ-120 (c): the repelling-endpoint definition of l.908–913 is equivalent to the l.915 form, for positive and for negative, in every degree k ≥ 1 (GX.GammaLinkCircle.isSpacelikePositive_iff_rep, isSpacelikeNegative_iff_att). It is not limited to degree 2: in the hyperbolic setting of l.893–895 the degree is even and the components of I⁺ are δ^{2i}]x₀, x₁[ in every degree. The SCOPE (f) argument of HSSingularities.lean is now formalized.

OQ-128's finding, sharpened at the level of one lifted pair: without the guard « g hyperbolic », at p ∈ dS² with f = δᵏ g, k ≥ 1 and g with a fixed point, l.915's inequality is equivalent to the repelling form if and only if g ≠ 1 (GX.GammaLinkCircle.IsLiftedDev.forms_iff_iff_ne_one; g ≠ 1 forces g hyperbolic there). At trivial Γ_p-holonomy (g = 1), l.915 holds and no fixed point is repelling, built in degree 4 (GX.exists_forms_differ); argued, not formalized, in every even degree, the regular link ℓ(p) (degree 2) included (AUDIT-1 minor). The two forms of l.915 and l.908–913 therefore part only outside the paper's « hyperbolic circle » setting.
questions: None new. OQ-120 (a) and (c) remain the author's to answer; this file proves the remark under each answer. Reading taken for moves: B ∈ SO₀(1,2) (l.616–623), as in HSAntipodal's IsIsoVia; a time-reversing B ∈ SO(1,2) exchanges i⁺ and i⁻ (argued, not formalized) and is not covered.

Reading taken for « left extremities of the components of I⁺ » (l.909, l.912): I⁺ = D(E⁻¹ i⁺(L)) ⊆ ℝP̃¹ (= linkCover⁻¹ i⁺(ℓ(p)) in degree ≠ 0, IsLiftedDev.iPlusTilde_eq), the left extremity of the component of t being sInf (connectedComponentIn I⁺ t); « repelling » is GX.GTilde.IsRepellingAt of HSSingularities (g x = x and nearby points moved strictly away). The paper's indexing x_{2i} = δ^i x₀ is not used; it gives the same set of points (iPlus_components).
